title: カートリッジ式コーキングガン
description: 建物保守や内装工事の作業台向けの手動コーキングガン。無地カートリッジ、開いた保持枠、先端が開いた中空ノズル、押し棒と曲げた引手、固定した握り・トリガー・解放片を造形。横置きの一姿勢で、充填材、吐出、ラチェットやトリガー動作は含みません。実際の密封・施工性能は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.134 × 0.072 × 0.474 m、4,620三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A manual caulking-gun prop for building-maintenance and interior-work benches, with unbranded cartridge, open cradle, hollow open-ended nozzle, plunger rod and bent pull hook, fixed grip, trigger and release tab. Presented on its side; sealant, dispensing, ratchet and trigger behavior are absent. Real sealing and application performance are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.134 × 0.072 × 0.474 m; 4,620 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
